Since 2011, South Street

Saving good people from bad coffee.

We founded Urban Ground in 2011 after many years working in hospitality in London, where great coffee was everywhere. Back then the specialty scene in Eastbourne was virtually non-existent, so intrepid pioneers we became.

Our success has been driven by great customer service, exceptional coffee and delicious food, served in a relaxed contemporary room for the community. We are blessed with regulars who have supported us from the first few days, and some of the team who started in the first year are still with us.

The coffee

Square Mile coffee, made to a recipe.

Our coffee comes from Square Mile Roasters, founded in London in 2008 by Anette Moldvaer and James Hoffmann, the 2007 World Barista Champion. Every drink is prepared to a specific recipe, so you get a perfectly crafted cup every time.

Our house espresso, Red Brick, is their seasonal blend. As the harvests change, so does it: sweet, balanced and smooth, with notes of chocolate and fruit. Alongside it we bring in guest roasters from around the country for the filter menu and the retail shelf.

There is always a selection of beans for home brewing, from £12.00, ground for your chosen brew method.

    Good to know

    Questions.

    The things people ask before they come. Anything else, call 01323 398221.

    What are your opening hours?

    Monday to Thursday 8am to 3:30pm, Friday and Saturday 8am to 4pm, Sunday 9am to 3pm. Brunch is served until 2:30pm Sunday to Thursday and 3pm on Friday and Saturday.

    Where are you?

    56 South Street, Eastbourne, BN21 4XB, in the town centre. Call us on 01323 398221.

    Can I book a table?

    Yes, we take bookings for brunch for groups of up to 8. Call us on 01323 398221.

    Can I hire Urban Ground for a private event?

    Yes. After hours we become a private, licensed venue for birthdays, family celebrations, office and Christmas parties, work get-togethers and cocktail parties. We tailor the food to your event, from canapés and finger buffets to hot and cold buffets and formal sit-down meals. Every event is quoted individually, so send us an enquiry or call 01323 398221.

    Where can I park?

    There is free 2-hour parking on Spencer Road, and metered parking on all the surrounding roads. The nearest car park is Devonshire Park Tennis Car Park.

    Are you dog-friendly?

    Sadly we cannot allow dogs inside, but you are very welcome to sit at our outdoor tables with your dog.

    Do you have outdoor seating?

    Yes, we have tables outside.

    Is Urban Ground accessible?

    There is a step at the entrance and we have a ramp available, so just let us know. We have a large accessible toilet.

    Are you child-friendly? Do you have high chairs?

    Yes, families are welcome and we have high chairs.

    Can I work on my laptop?

    Yes, laptops are welcome Monday to Friday, but not at weekends. We are a small independent business and rely on a turnover of seats, so please be mindful at busy times.

    Do you take cash?

    No, we are card only.

    Do you do takeaway or online ordering?

    Yes. Everything is available to take away, and you can order online for click and collect through our online ordering page.

    Do you have vegan and gluten free options?

    Yes. We always have a vegan and a gluten free cake, and several brunch dishes are vegan or can be made gluten free. Our kitchen handles all allergens, so please tell the team about any allergies.

    What coffee do you serve?

    Square Mile Roasters from London. Our house espresso, Red Brick, changes several times a year with the seasons, and our baristas make every drink to a set recipe. Our milk comes from Northiam Dairy on the Kent and Sussex border: pasteurised but not homogenised.

    We've been saving good people from bad coffee, in the heart of Eastbourne, since 2011.

              You told me the things that eat your time are the till, stock, margins and recipes, and that you want income from more than the people who walk past.
